summary: Generic forward iteration helper: calls the __thiscall callback a4(a1) exactly a3 times, advancing the element pointer a1 by the stride a2 after every call. Returns the counter i at loop exit, which is a3 when the loop ran to completion and 0 when a3 is <= 0. Forward-iterating counterpart of the countdown callback loop family and gated by an SEH frame visible only in the packet globals.

operations.description: Seed result with the current counter i at the top of every iteration.
Iterate counter i upward from 0 without a static bound in the source; the loop terminates on the guard below.
Break out of the loop when i >= a3; when a3 is <= 0 the body never executes and the function returns 0.
Invoke the __thiscall callback a4(a1) on the current element; the call edge targets the delegate sub_58A677.
Advance the element pointer by the stride: a1 += a2.
Return the final counter i (a3 when the loop completes, 0 when a3 <= 0).
